dover.s1_head: Dover's port economy and professional firms
s1loc: The Port of Dover anchors the local economy, handling roll-on roll-off freight and the cross-Channel traffic that supports a dense cluster of haulage, customs and logistics operators along the Eastern Docks and the White Cliffs Business Park. The Dover Western Docks Revival reshaped the waterfront and cargo terminal, drawing in fresh investment. Professional firms work alongside them: MFW Chartered Accountants and Beverton and Co handle the books, while Setfords and Shelagh Vines cover legal and conveyancing work across the district.

Dover's professional workforce spans accountancy, law, insurance and the advisory firms serving the port supply chain and Dover District Council.
